messages.subject: impution in part2
parts:
Hi all, 

I would like to know if there is any possibility of turning off the imputation in part2, in order to get the actual acceleration in CSV for non-wear time, or its default pre-processing done by GGIR. 

I would really appreciate it if someone could answer. 

Kind Regards, 

Abdul Haleem

messages.author: e17dc21aa6c006ab
messages.subject: Re: impution in part2
parts:
Hi all, 

just add one more question, related to imitation done in part2, since in the time series CSV I can see non-wear time was also labeled with some behavioral activities code, there is any possibility of having non-wear time without these behavioral codes with real non-wear labeling or we always have time-series with these behavioral codes.

Kind Regards, 

Abdul Haleem

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: impution in part2

Yes, that is correct. Boolean argument do.imp is how you can tell GGIR to not impute the data. 

Best, Vincent
